title: State (NCT of Delhi) v. Navjot Sandhu @ Afsan Guru

content.caseIdentity: State (NCT of Delhi) v. Navjot Sandhu @ Afsan Guru, (2005) 11 SCC 600
content.holding: The Parliament attack decision establishing the definitive limitation on Section 8 BSA (old s. 10 IEA): statements made by a conspirator after arrest are narratives of past events and cannot be admitted against co-conspirators because agency terminates upon arrest.
